title: MTW Project Record
description: Schema for a single Mad Tinker's Workshop project entry in TinkerOps registry

id.description: Unique identifier, matches folder name exactly

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the project

enumDescriptions.dormant: Built, not being touched right now, may resume
enumDescriptions.placeholder: Folder exists intentionally, content lives elsewhere or not yet started
enumDescriptions.pre-build: Fully designed and documented, not yet coded
enumDescriptions.complete: Shipped and done, no planned changes
enumDescriptions.archived: Dead or superseded, kept for reference only

division.description: MTW division this project belongs to, null if root-level

path.description: Absolute path on Vulcain's Forge (Q:) or other drive

alt_path.description: Secondary path if project spans drives or has a companion location

package_manager.description: Primary package manager for this project

deployment.description: Where this project is deployed or intended to run

github.description: GitHub repo path under Mad-Tinker-MTW org

docs.description: Which documentation files exist for this project

pmp_ids.description: PMP document ID prefix if PMP stack exists

launch.description: Launch script filename relative to project root

launch_cmd.description: Manual launch command if no script exists yet

clean_cmd.description: Housekeeping command that removes regenerable artifacts; surfaced as the card clean button. Run server-side from the project path; must be safe and non-interactive.

release.description: Release codename and version shown on the card as the shipped/done indicator (a finished project kept in the active list). Format: '<Codename> v<X.Y.Z>'. Codenames follow a mythology theme (TinkerOps started with Ares). Display only.

port.description: Local dev server port if applicable

last_worked.description: ISO date of last active session

last_commit.description: ISO date of last git commit

summary.description: 2-3 sentence description of what this project is and does

tags.description: Freeform tags for filtering and grouping

blocked_by.description: Project ID this depends on before it can be built

triage_needed.description: True if this record is incomplete and needs a manual review pass

uat.description: True if this is UAT coursework, grouped under the dashboard UAT toggle (default on). Toggling off in TinkerOps marks it 'to be moved' (persisted client-side in localStorage; the dashboard has no backend to write the registry).

notes.description: Freeform internal notes, migration plans, known issues
